experiences.description: Supervised ideation, planning, and end-to-end execution of ~50 competitions across India. Managed 10,000+ participants, coordinating logistics, outreach, and on-ground operations.
Coordinated logistics and on-ground execution for multiple events at IIT Guwahati's annual sports festival.

projects.title: Campus Placement Analytics Portal
projects.description: Designed normalized MySQL database modeling 5 years of placement data across 15+ IITs. Built RESTful PHP backend with parameterized PDO queries, reducing SQL injection risks and improving query performance by 40%. Implemented dynamic visualizations (Bar, Stacked Area, Heatmap, Treemap) via Chart.js with client-side filtering.

projects.title: Personal Knowledge Graph for Conceptual Learning
projects.description: Architected full-stack REST API backend using Node.js, Express, and MySQL graph modeling for conceptual dependencies and backlinks. Engineered MVC controllers and routes for notes and graph traversal. Built interactive SVG graph visualization in React with dynamic node selection.

projects.title: CardioDetect: Deep Learning and Hybrid ML Pipeline
projects.description: Developed custom 3-block CNN in PyTorch using BatchNorm, LeakyReLU, and Dropout to classify ECG images into 4 cardiac conditions with 97.31% accuracy. Built hybrid pipeline extracting CNN feature embeddings and training SVM and Naive Bayes classifiers, achieving 98.39% accuracy.
